date_note: The page gives only its own publication day, 25 November 2026.
title: NordPass report: "123456" is the most common password worldwide, "admin" in Italy
summary: Cybersecurity Trends reports on NordPass's eighth annual list of the most common passwords, covering credentials exposed between September 2025 and September 2026 in 44 countries. According to the article, "123456" is the most common password globally and "admin" ranks first in Italy for the second year running. NordPass recommends long passwords, unique per account, and multi-factor authentication.
plain: NordPass's yearly list of the most common passwords, as reported by Cybersecurity Trends, again puts "123456" first worldwide and "admin" first in Italy.
exec: NordPass's 2026 list, as reported by Cybersecurity Trends, shows "123456" is still the most common password worldwide, and "admin" in Italy.
action: NordPass advises long passwords mixing letters, numbers and special characters, a unique password per account, and multi-factor authentication.
